Abdulaziz Hatem.note: Hatem is defined by organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Abdulaziz Hatem.noteZh: 他靠在危险出现前组织好队友与同位置球员拉开差异。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ahmed Alaaeldin.note: Alaaeldin is defined by starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ahmed Alaaeldin.noteZh: 他靠在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ahmed Alganehi.summary: Ahmed Al-Ganehi is a Qatari professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Al-Gharafa and the Qatar national team.
Ahmed Alganehi.note: Al-Ganehi is defined by explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Ahmed Alganehi.noteZh: 他靠看到空当后的爆发速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Ahmed Fathy.note: Fathy is defined by choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Ahmed Fathy.noteZh: 他靠选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Akram Afif.note: Watch Afif for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Akram Afif.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Alhashmi Alhussein.note: Al-Hussain stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Alhashmi Alhussein.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Almoez Ali.note: Ali's signature is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Almoez Ali.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用有目的的无球移动创造接应点上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Assim Madibo.note: Madibo stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Assim Madibo.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Ayoub Aloui.summary: Ayoub Mohamed Aloui is a Qatari defender who plays for Al-Gharafa and has represented Qatar at youth and senior national-team level.
Ayoub Aloui.note: Aloui stands out for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Ayoub Aloui.noteZh: 他的突出特点是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Boualem Khoukhi.note: Khoukhi is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Boualem Khoukhi.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Edmilson Junior.note: Junior is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Edmilson Junior.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Hassan Alhaydos.note: Al-Haydos's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Hassan Alhaydos.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Homam Ahmed.note: Ahmed is defined by choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Homam Ahmed.noteZh: 他靠从后场加入进攻的启动时机与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Issa Laye.note: Laye stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Issa Laye.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Jassem Gaber.note: Gaber is defined by moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Jassem Gaber.noteZh: 他靠用传球的力度和角度移动防线与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Karim Boudiaf.note: Watch Boudiaf for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Karim Boudiaf.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。留意他如何判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Lucas Mendes.note: Mendes stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Lucas Mendes.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Mahmoud Abunada.note: Watch Abunada for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Mahmoud Abunada.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。留意他如何判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Meshaal Barsham.note: Watch Barsham for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Meshaal Barsham.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。留意他如何保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Mohamed Manai.note: Manai is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Mohamed Manai.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Mohammed Muntari.note: Muntari's signature is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Mohammed Muntari.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用上。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Pedro Miguel.note: Miguel's edge is using strength without slowing the next action. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Pedro Miguel.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Salah Zakaria.note: Zakaria is defined by sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Salah Zakaria.noteZh: 他靠提前站位后的快速反应与同位置球员拉开差异。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Sultan Albrake.note: Al-Brake's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Sultan Albrake.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Tahsin Mohammed.note: Watch Jamshid for explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Tahsin Mohammed.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。留意他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Yusuf Abdurisag.note: Abdurisag stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Yusuf Abdurisag.noteZh: 他的突出特点是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。
